Class ClassDependencyIndex

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.dev.compile.ClassDependencyIndex
public final class ClassDependencyIndex extends Object
Which top-level classes of a class output directory reference which, read from the constant pools of the class files, so that an incremental compilation recompiles the sources whose classes link against a changed class.

The index over-approximates on purpose: every class name a constant pool mentions counts as a reference, including ones that appear only in a descriptor. Recompiling a source that did not strictly need it is cheap; missing one that did leaves the output inconsistent.

Since:
5.3.0
Author:
graemerocher

    • declaresConstants

      public boolean declaresConstants(String topLevelClass)
      Whether a top-level class, or a class nested in it, declares a compile-time constant: a static final field with a constant value, which javac inlines into the classes that read it, leaving no reference in their constant pools for the index to follow.
      Parameters:
      topLevelClass - The binary name
      Returns:
      True if a change to the class can change the classes that read its constants without the index knowing
